from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import io
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch


def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-commit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cache", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cached-self-check", action="store_true")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    root = arguments.root.resolve()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "scripts"))
    import patch_window_analysis as analysis

    source_path = root / "scripts/patch_window_analysis.py"
    source_bytes = source_path.read_bytes()
    if arguments.cached_self_check:
        cache = json.loads(arguments.cache.read_text())
        if digest(source_bytes) != cache["source_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Source changed before cached self-check")
    else:
        old_source = subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "-C", str(root), "show", arguments.baseline_commit + ":scripts/patch_window_analysis.py"]
        )
        old_tree, new_tree = ast.parse(old_source), ast.parse(source_bytes)
        old_fit = next(node for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "fit_ramsey")
        new_fit = next(node for node in new_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "fit_ramsey")
        if ast.dump(old_fit) != ast.dump(new_fit):
            raise RuntimeError("fit_ramsey differs from the historical fitter")
        check = copy.deepcopy(next(node for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "self_check"))
        trial_index, trial = next((index, node) for index, node in enumerate(check.body) if isinstance(node, ast.For) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id == "_trial")
        fit_index = next(index for index, node in enumerate(trial.body) if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) and node.value.func.id == "fit_ramsey")
        trial.body = trial.body[:fit_index] + ast.parse("captured.append(points)").body
        check.name = "old_samples"
        check.body = check.body[:trial_index] + ast.parse("captured = []").body + [trial] + ast.parse("return captured").body
        namespace = dict(analysis.__dict__)
        exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[check], type_ignores=[])), "<historical-sampler>", "exec"), namespace)
        old_samples = namespace["old_samples"]()
        samples = analysis._planted_detuning_samples(0.06, 20)
        if encoded(old_samples) != encoded(samples):
            raise RuntimeError("Extracted sampler changes the historical generator stream")
        os.environ["GOROROBA_WORKERS"] = "1"
        started = time.perf_counter()
        serial = analysis.parallel.ordered_map(analysis.fit_ramsey, samples, min_items=2)
        serial_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
        print("serial", serial_seconds, flush=True)
        os.environ["GOROROBA_WORKERS"] = "4"
        started = time.perf_counter()
        pooled = analysis.parallel.ordered_map(analysis.fit_ramsey, samples, min_items=2)
        pooled_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
        print("pooled", pooled_seconds, flush=True)
        if encoded(serial) != encoded(pooled):
            raise RuntimeError("Serial and four-worker fit outputs differ")
        if source_path.read_bytes() != source_bytes:
            raise RuntimeError("Source changes during qualification")
        cache = {
            "source_sha256": digest(source_bytes),
            "baseline_commit": arguments.baseline_commit,
            "baseline_source_sha256": digest(old_source),
            "fitter_ast_sha256": digest(ast.dump(new_fit).encode()),
            "stream_sha256": digest(encoded(samples)),
            "reference_stream_sha256": digest(encoded(old_samples)),
            "serial_results_sha256": digest(encoded(serial)),
            "pooled_results_sha256": digest(encoded(pooled)),
            "trials": len(samples),
            "points_per_trial": [len(sample) for sample in samples],
            "serial_seconds": serial_seconds,
            "pooled_seconds_including_spawn": pooled_seconds,
            "available_cpus": analysis.parallel.available_cpus(),
            "pooled_workers": analysis.parallel.workers(),
            "stream": samples,
            "results": pooled,
            "versions": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ("numpy", "scipy", "qiskit")},
            "python": sys.version,
            "executable": sys.executable,
            "platform": platform.platform(),
            "environment": {name: os.environ.get(name) for name in ("GLIBC_TUNABLES", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "RAYON_NUM_THREADS", "QISKIT_NUM_PROCS")},
        }
        arguments.cache.write_text(json.dumps(cache, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    real_map = analysis.parallel.ordered_map

    def verified_map(function, items, min_items=64):
        if function is not analysis.fit_ramsey or digest(encoded(items)) != cache["stream_sha256"]:
            return real_map(function, items, min_items=min_items)
        if digest(encoded(cache["results"])) != cache["pooled_results_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Cached fits differ from the verified pooled outputs")
        return copy.deepcopy(cache["results"])

    os.environ["GOROROBA_WORKERS"] = "4"
    output = io.StringIO()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with patch.object(analysis.parallel, "ordered_map", verified_map), redirect_stdout(output):
        analysis.self_check()
    if source_path.read_bytes() != source_bytes:
        raise RuntimeError("Source changes during self-check")
    result = {
        "optimization": sys.flags.optimize,
        "passed": True,
        "stdout": output.getvalue(),
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "method": "Exact source/stream/result-digest-bound reuse of the independently computed four-worker fits; every remaining self-check computation executes normally.",
    }
    arguments.cache.with_name("self-check-" + str(sys.flags.optimize) + ".json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(result, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
